sn1.3:1.1: At Sāvatthī. Standing to one side, that devata recited this verse in the presence of the Blessed One:
sn1.3:1.2:
"Life is swept along, short is the life span;
No shelters exist for one who has reached old age.
Seeing clearly this danger in death,
One should do deeds of merit that bring happiness." "Life is swept along, short is the life span;
No shelters exist for one who has reached old age.
Seeing clearly this danger in death,
A seeker of peace should drop the world's bait."
